P operators with a `layout` field are bound to design/layouts/<stem>.json. Unbound P operators name elements that no layout file holds (proposed elements of this aspect, native select popups, cross-screen moves) and keep 1.1 s in every column.
Expert, error-free, routine execution only; reading the returned proposal is not modelled.

Task id T13-intent is aspect-local: it covers asking from a typed intent. design/brief.json T13 is 'ask AI at a selected element' (see design/tasks/ia-flows.json); the two ids are not merged.
